arguments.title: Apple Pop Banana Bop - Dance Hook | MomoTime
arguments.lyrics:
[Dance Hook - punchy rhythmic singing]
Apple, pop! Apple, pop!
Apple, apple, pop-pop-pop!
Banana, bop! Banana, bop!
Banana, banana, bop-bop-bop!

[Repeat Dance Hook - identical catchy rhythm and melody]
Apple, pop! Apple, pop!
Apple, apple, pop-pop-pop!
Banana, bop! Banana, bop!
Banana, banana, bop-bop-bop!

[End - final hit]
arguments.style: English preschool KIDS DANCE POP, 124 bpm, tight bouncy 4/4 dance groove, punchy kick, crisp clap-snare backbeat, springy syncopated synth bass, playful offbeat plucks, bright cute childlike girl lead, clear energetic rhythmic singing, punchy short syllables locked to the beat, a catchy original two-bar melodic-rhythmic motif repeated exactly, fruit names as the call and pop-pop/bop-bop as the rhythmic answer, tiny anticipations and stop-start accents, instantly memorable playground dance hook, simple tune with a strong rhythmic identity, voice and groove equally forward, lively but not aggressive, immediate sung hook, 30-second chorus audition, clean final hit
